steps.speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
steps.content: The energy of the crystals is pouring out. This is the inheritance! I'll kill you, kill the Legion... I can pull this off now.

steps.speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
steps.content: I don't have to take orders from others anymore! The Syndicate is mine to take! Hahahaha!!
The Mania crystals in their hands start burning, and the patterns on the altar are spreading out. The overpowering sound of a thumping heart is shaking the crypt.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...I am feeling miserable, so many voices in my head... Ugh... shut up, shut up...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Abort the mission and get out of here... The inheritance is penetrating the shackles, and you will...

An excruciating pain assails your head, and you feel as if countless avaricious hands were tearing at your soul. In a trance, you see the gangsters rush towards the stone altar like squirmy dark shapes.
The stone altar, there's something... someone who...

A chill washes over you. Close by your side, a dark blur leaps up and hurls herself into the center of the chaos. The sweeping ax gives out a black energy beam in the shape of a blade and tears apart several enemies in the front.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: You scumbags... You think you can hold the Legion back...?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I won't let you have your way, not as long as I'm still around... I will not let her fall!
